summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any code or tests, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with start/stop per dimension including channel; set_rnd skips double-underscore attribute names; docstrings updated). monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter with delegation to iter_patch; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with NumPy ceiling for worker split and the exact NotImplementedError message; PatchDataset docstring np.float replaced by float; math import removed). monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset. tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape (module-level generator) and test_loading_array using the spec's pinned values. Caveats: nothing was executed, so the pinned two-worker values are unverified; that block reuses the dataset without extra reseeding, which may not match the reference RNG ordering. Two long lines in utils.py (231-233) predate this change and were left alone.
